references.title: DWDS: fast
references.supports: No Wortzerlegung; Etymologie: 'das umlautlose Adverb zu ... fest'

notes.rationale: sah man dagegen fast allzu deutlich an, almost. An ADV takes no Source (ADR 0050), so it is a bottom word. DWDS gives no Wortzerlegung, so it is a bottom word, and indeclinable, so it has no Ending, not even ∅ (ADR 0051): the Root fast alone.
